annotations.title: Suburb · Leased rents by bedroom, Queensland

description:
Median weekly rent on new Queensland tenancies, and the number of new bonds, each quarter by dwelling type and bedrooms (flats, houses, townhouses), for Queensland suburbs (from 2017) and postcodes (from 2012).

Coverage: Queensland suburbs (September quarter 2017 onwards) and postcodes (March quarter 2012 onwards) with any published value. Current to 2026-09-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/leased-rents-qld`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: rent_all, rent_flat_1bed, rent_flat_2bed, rent_flat_3bed, rent_house_2bed, rent_house_3bed, rent_house_4bed, rent_townhouse_2bed, rent_townhouse_3bed, bonds_all, bonds_flat_1bed, bonds_flat_2bed, bonds_flat_3bed, bonds_house_2bed, bonds_house_3bed, bonds_house_4bed, bonds_townhouse_2bed, bonds_townhouse_3bed. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
